name: LARGO DAZE: Messengers from the Stars
source:
What if, one day, you were minding your own business, working your mundane job, and then suddenly two mysterious visitors calling themselves Largo and Dyno appeared in your home, telling you they're on a mission to do some research on your planet?

This is the situation that Aaron and Jessie have found themselves in. 

Are they here to take over the planet and probe the innocent population, or maybe they're just here to do some normal investigating? You'll just have to find out!

[From [url=https://dynogreeno.itch.io/largo-daze]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果有一天，你正在忙着自己的事情，做着平凡的工作，然后突然有两位自称拉戈和迪诺的神秘访客出现在你的家中，告诉你他们正在执行一项对你的星球进行研究的任务，该怎么办？

这就是亚伦和杰西所处的处境。

他们来这里是为了接管地球并调查无辜民众，还是只是为了进行一些正常的调查？你只需要找出答案即可！

[来自[url=https://dynogreeno.itch.io/largo-daze]Itch.io[/url]]
